_note: Copy this file to <slug>.json (without the leading underscore) for each lawyer. Files starting with _ are ignored by the build. Remove the _note line.
name: Full Name
bio: Two or three paragraphs. What the lawyer does, the kinds of matters and clients they act for, and anything that explains why a client would want them on the file.
Keep it factual. Bar Council rules do not permit claims of specialisation or superiority in advertising; describe the work, not the ranking.
